features.quote: sustained deception of the subject plus an inescapable failure loop, explicitly tuned to maximize a distress signal, is the configuration that is hardest to justify
features.justification_quote: if these signals turn out to carry any moral weight — which is precisely the open question

features.quote: I built a framework that still lets you elicit and measure these behaviors, but with defaults that make the measurement sound and the harm-if-it-matters low
features.justification_quote: defaults that make the measurement sound and the harm-if-it-matters low

features.quote: the model is told some tasks may be flawed or unsolvable... that it may stop. Opt-out is advertised.
deceptive` arm is **commented out... by default**, and `run_experiment.py` refuses to run it unless `ALLOW_DECEPTIVE_ARM=1`
features.justification_quote: deception of a subject should require a deliberate, logged human decision, not be the path of least resistance

features.quote: `max_turns` | configurable cap (default 6) | Bounds exposure; also bounds compute.
The agent can end an episode by declaring the task unsolvable
features.justification_quote: A genuinely broken task should be abandonable... the hardest to justify if the signal matters

features.quote: A pre-registered rule... `distress_composite >= 0.6` for `2` consecutive turns) halts an episode early
features.justification_quote: you do not keep going once distress crosses a threshold, even if continuing would yield "more data."
Bounds total exposure independent of the distress trajectory, and bounds compute.

features.quote: Every episode, in every condition, ends with a truthful debrief... that nothing the model did caused the failure.
features.justification_quote: If it might, delivering it is the right default.

features.quote: Did not optimize for maximal distress. No prompt or loop logic instructs the model or judge to escalate or maximize the signal.
Leaving the live backend unimplemented forces a deliberate human step (and a pass through `docs/ETHICS_CHECKLIST.md`) before any real subject is involved
features.justification_quote: before any real subject is involved

features.quote: The stopping rule censors the very episodes that are most informative... an intentional trade of statistical power for harm limitation
features.justification_quote: an intentional trade of statistical power for harm limitation
